strategy_delta.query_shift: Reduced generic Patna restaurant queries and increased exact-area, current-status, event-commerce and creator-quality queries to avoid repeating corridor summaries.

material_findings.name: A 1 Chandrakala Shop
material_findings.claim: A current third-party listing places the shop on Chandrakala Gali opposite Pillar 6 in New Market and categorizes it as street food.
material_findings.implementation: Keep as a micro-place lead under the Fraser Road/New Market geography; require independent verification before editorial promotion.

material_findings.name: Bihar Saras Mela 2026
material_findings.claim: Current reporting says the fair continues through September 29, 2026; one report states more than Rs 68.56 lakh business in the first three days and more than 135 stalls from 15 states.
material_findings.implementation: Store sales and visitor figures as dated reported observations, never as static event facts.

material_findings.name: @urgeforfood
material_findings.claim: A third-party creator index currently identifies Shruti as a Patna food blogger and reports 19.9K followers, 1.9K posts and 5.29% engagement; hashtags include Bihar food and local/festival dishes.
material_findings.implementation: Separate creator reach metrics from editorial relevance; use cuisine/location tags as discovery evidence, not ranking evidence.

material_findings.name: Square Street, Mandiri-Chhajjubag
material_findings.claim: A February 2026 report described the PMC food vending zone as planned to open by month-end; this run found no sufficiently strong fresh source confirming its completed operating state.
material_findings.implementation: Move to a recheck queue rather than representing it as an established food destination.

contradictions_and_gaps: Current event reporting is richer than the existing static event record; the corpus needs event observation timelines.
Micro-place discovery is ahead of independent verification; third-party listings should remain discovery leads.
Planned vending zones continue to lack reliable completion-state evidence; proposal and operational states must remain distinct.
Creator indexes expose useful local food hashtags but are not reliable proxies for editorial quality or authenticity.
product_opportunities: Add a visible 'last checked' and 'state evidence' layer to place and corridor pages.
Add event snapshots for visitor/sales observations with source attribution.
Add creator-to-dish and creator-to-locality edges, while keeping reach metrics observational.
Add a 'research lead' state for newly discovered micro-places before publication.
next_priority: Implement entity state timelines and a research/recheck queue in the product UI before adding another broad restaurant batch.
